kinSays.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Norman Schubert. Bus driver. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Trail compass, Brass Locket, Unnamed photograph, Dispatcher's headset, Dead Phone. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night, something walked past the treeline on two legs. Too tall. It stopped. It listened. Then it kept going. Nobody slept after that.

◈ FLASHBACK — Unnamed photograph
There is a name you won't say out loud anymore. The photo doesn't need you to say it. Somebody you loved didn't make it to the clearing, and this is what's left of the proof they were here.
💛 The Unnamed photograph is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — resolve: trauma lands a quarter lighter, while worn.)

◈ FLASHBACK — Brass Locket

◈ FLASHBACK — Trail compass
Lost above the fog line, visibility down to your boots. You didn't panic — just held the compass flat, found north, and walked out like it was nothing. It was not nothing.
